context:
You asked, 14:45 CDT: can it be a true/false switch, in a file or a guard, that turns the grant on or off, instead of a line in the parent CLAUDE.md? Yes: that is option c below. Your rules already allow a grant to live in the merge tool's settings instead of CLAUDE.md.

You asked, 12:45 CDT: why not keep the grant in the coordinator's handoff or memory? A handoff and memory belong to one session and are deleted when it ends, so the next coordinator would not see the grant. Its lasting home is the record standing-merge-grant on main.

Your 16:47 CDT grant (the coordinator merges in every repo until you withdraw it) has a record, #824. claude-settings' own .claude/CLAUDE.md has no line for it. Meanwhile the coordinator keeps merging under the grant.

options.gain: A session here sees the grant before it reads any file, like the child repos.
options.how: One line in claude-settings' .claude/CLAUDE.md, written by a lane on your yes.
options.label: Add the line
options.lose: One more line in a file every session here loads.

options.gain: Nothing to build; the grant still lives on main for every coordinator.
options.how: The record standing-merge-grant on main stays the only home.
options.label: Keep it in the record only
options.lose: A session here must find the record to know the grant; no switch to turn it off.

options.gain: One true/false switch turns the grant on or off; the merge tool obeys it, so no session has to remember it.
options.how: A lane adds standing_grant: true to the merge tool's settings file on main; the merge tool refuses a coordinator merge when it is false. You flip it in one line, or tell a session to.
options.label: A true/false switch in the merge tool's settings
options.lose: A small code change to the merge tool and its test.

ref: coordinator-merge-grant; your standing merge grant, chat Oct 29 16:47 CDT; record standing-merge-grant (#824)
title: Put your standing merge grant in claude-settings' own CLAUDE.md?
why: A switch the merge tool reads does the job your question asks for: one place to turn it off, nothing added to CLAUDE.md.
